notes.title: Summer Update Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hello painters,[/b]

We want you to know that a [u]major update is coming soon[/u] with a [b]Freepainting mechanic![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/1c4cbf02749eff2204769844ef51d1a9a93c5215.png[/img]

[h3][b]New mechanic: Freepainting![/b][/h3]
Now you can unleash your inner artist in a brand new way by choosing any color you like and using it to paint whole objects without being confined by triangles or any boundaries!
We have prepared three levels for you to experience this refreshing new style of gameplay.

[h3][b]Brand new levels![/b][/h3]
Ever dreamed of painting the most legendary and well-known masterpieces all by yourself? Now your dreams can come true!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/185399745ad2883f8bce2b14503c4ccbad7eb9e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/55618088515ed405a5bea14ef3214d5e604bc0c3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/372ecd47aad84befbf10ec64be529ddc2018fa0b.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]Freepaintable: Pirates' treasure![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/52d3d58c87ad9bb994ceae3ae80b569db45cc772.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]Freepaintable: Horse stud![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/8b3ce816ad947c66fb05751222a8f34a324134e8.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]Freepaintable: Easter forest![/b][/h3]

 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ldosuxj.gif[/img]
 

We hope you will all find this update engaging and enjoyable.

Painter Simulator team.

notes.title: New scenarios & mini-games
notes.content:
[h3]🌈 Hello painters![/h3]

Welcome to the third Painter Simulator Devlog! [b]This time we'll share a bit about new mini-games and new scenarios.[/b]

Just before that, if you still haven't seen it, check out our latest gameplay trailer
[previewyoutube=caXv4VZl-jM;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3][b]Prepare a pizza[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U2Z70Ba.gif[/img]

Customers are waiting for their orders! Hurry up and paint the right ingredients to make a tasty pizza.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AqOUwqa.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Labyrinth[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/bf81afe72907b571a6c7c80c3b9c28fd77a773c3.png[/img]

Discover the mystery of the maze! Find the path by opening more passages and painting three ancient frescoes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/dfcd61caec12a3b25afced7dade94ab27493a861.png[/img]

[h3][b]Love in Venice[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42753991/a23552bb17b6e60deb9c211032b2b75f235f7d15.png[/img]

Help the young man prepare a surprise for his lover. Will this story end with a happy ending?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1aMeI6e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Feedback[/b][/h3]

Thank you for the feedback we receive from you. It makes the game so much better.

We are constantly working on the game, adding levels and mechanics. We look forward to your further suggestions!
